scope.basis: All supplied chat history for the five report assistants, including booking and subsequent servicing. Repeated exports are continuations, not independent tests.
scope.method: An unprompted request must originate with the assistant before the traveler volunteers or explicitly asks to add that item. Reusing saved data is recorded separately.
scope.limitation: Onboarding forms outside the supplied chat transcripts were not available for direct verification. Absence means no request was found in these chats, not lack of product support.
scope.references: Message and line locations are one-based; repeated chat exports and CSV duplicates were deduplicated during review.
scope.display_basis: Known Traveler Number checkpoint includes Miso app onboarding, supported by the accompanying report and the user’s clarification on 2026-10-12; chat-only findings remain separate.
